The burden beyond a reasonable doubt rests on the Crown, and disputed attribution alone does not establish receipt.

E-002 records Tavi stating Fictional Morgan left with the token still in hand and that no handover was seen. Neither account is established proof. Attribution alone cannot satisfy the Crown's burden beyond a reasonable doubt on the listed receipt element, and no further evidence is offered.
